concepts.title: Handpicking
concepts.definition: In brief, a manual method of separation where larger-sized impurities like stones, husk, or dirt are directly picked out by hand from grains or pulses.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Utilizing differences in size, shape, or color of impurities to manually remove them.
question_patterns: how can we separate stones from wheat grains
explain the method of handpicking with an example
when is handpicking a convenient method of separation
what is the process of handpicking
how to remove dirt and husk from pulses manually

solution_steps.explain: Observe the mixture to find differences in size, shape, or color between the useful component and the impurities.
Use hands to select and remove the larger unwanted particles (like stones or husk) from the grains.

concepts.title: Threshing
concepts.definition: The process of beating harvested stalks against a hard surface to free and separate the grain seeds from the stalks.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Beating stalks to release smaller, tightly attached grain seeds.
question_patterns: how are grain seeds separated from stalks
what is threshing and how is it done
explain the process of threshing
why can we not separate grain seeds from stalks by handpicking
describe the method used to free grains from dried stalks

solution_steps.explain: Stalks are dried in the sun before separation so that the grains loosen.
The dried stalks are beaten against a hard surface (manually, using bullocks, or machines) to free the grain seeds.

concepts.title: Winnowing
concepts.definition: In brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, a method used to separate heavier constituents from lighter constituents of a mixture using wind or blowing air.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, Utilizing the difference in weight of components under the influence of moving air.
question_patterns: what is winnowing and where is it used
how can we separate lighter husk from heavier grain seeds
explain the principle of winnowing
describe the process of winnowing with steps
how do farmers separate husk from grain

solution_steps.explain: Hold the mixture on a plate or sheet at shoulder height on a raised platform.
Tilt the plate slightly so the mixture slides out; the blowing wind carries away the lighter husk while the heavier grains fall straight down to form a heap.

concepts.title: Sieving
concepts.definition: A separation technique that uses a mesh or sieve to separate constituents of a mixture using their different particle sizes.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, Smaller particles pass through the sieve's holes while larger particles are retained.
question_patterns: what is sieving and where is it used
how to separate pebbles and stones from sand
can we separate flour and powdered chalk by sieving
explain the principle of sieving
how is bran removed from flour

solution_steps.explain: Pour the mixture onto a sieve with appropriate hole size.
The fine particles pass through the holes, while the larger impurities remain on the sieve.

concepts.title: Sedimentation
concepts.definition: In brief, the process where heavier, insoluble solid particles in a liquid mixture settle down at the container's bottom after standing undisturbed.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Gravity pulls down heavier insoluble solids in a liquid.
question_patterns: what is sedimentation
how do dust and soil particles settle when water is added to rice
explain the process of sedimentation with an example
what happens when muddy water is left undisturbed
define sedimentation in separation of mixtures

solution_steps.action: Add liquid and let it stand
solution_steps.explain: Mix the solid-liquid mixture and allow it to remain undisturbed for some time.
The heavier insoluble solid particles settle down at the bottom of the vessel under gravity.

concepts.title: Decantation
concepts.definition: The process of pouring out the upper liquid layer without disturbing the settled sediment at the bottom, or separating two immiscible liquids.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, Separating the top liquid layer from a settled solid or a different liquid layer.
question_patterns: what is decantation
how can we separate oil and water from their mixture
explain how to separate sand and water using decantation
describe the step after sedimentation to remove water
how is dirty water poured off from soaked rice

solution_steps.explain: Slowly tilt the vessel containing the settled sediment or immiscible layers.
Pour the upper liquid layer into another container without disturbing the settled solid or the bottom liquid layer.

concepts.title: Filtration
concepts.definition: A method used to separate insoluble solid particles from a liquid by passing the mixture through a porous medium like a strainer, cloth, or filter paper.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Using a physical barrier with fine pores to trap solid particles while letting liquid pass.
question_patterns: what is filtration and give an example
how to obtain clear water from muddy water using filter paper
how is cottage cheese or paneer separated from liquid
which method is better for separating tea leaves: decantation or filtration
explain the use of filter paper in filtration

solution_steps.explain: Pour the mixture through a porous medium such as a strainer, cloth, or filter paper cone.
The liquid (filtrate) passes through the pores, while the solid particles (residue) are retained on the filter.

concepts.title: Evaporation
concepts.definition: The process of converting a liquid into its gaseous or vapour state, used to separate a soluble solid from its liquid solvent.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Heating a solution to vaporize the liquid, leaving the dissolved solid behind.
question_patterns: what is evaporation
how is common salt obtained from sea water
how to separate salt from salt water mixture
explain the process of evaporation with an activity
how does water turn into water vapour continuously

solution_steps.explain: Heat the liquid containing the dissolved solid until it boils or evaporates.
The liquid turns into vapour and escapes, leaving the solid solute behind in the container.

concepts.title: Condensation
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, the action of converting water vapour (or any gas) back into its liquid form by cooling.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Cooling gas to turn it back into liquid.
question_patterns: what is condensation
how to recover water from steam during distillation
explain the process of condensation with an example
what happens when steam touches a cold metal plate
define condensation in the context of separating mixtures

solution_steps.explain: Bring the hot vapour or steam into contact with a cold surface.
The vapour loses heat, condenses into liquid droplets, and is collected.

concepts.title: Saturated Solution
concepts.section: Can water dissolve any amount of a substance?
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, a solution where no more solute can indeed be dissolved at a given temperature.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: A limit exists on how much solute can dissolve in a fixed volume of solvent at a specific temperature.
question_patterns: what is a saturated solution
how can we dissolve more salt in a saturated solution
does water dissolve equal amounts of different soluble substances
what happens when you heat a saturated solution
how to prepare a saturated solution of sugar

solution_steps.action: Add solute until it stops dissolving
solution_steps.explain: Add solute to a fixed quantity of solvent with continuous stirring until some solute remains undissolved at the bottom.
Heat the saturated solution to dissolve the remaining solute, demonstrating that solubility increases with temperature.

worked_examples.question_pattern: How can you separate a mixture of sand, salt, and water?

solution_template.explain: Allow the mixture to stand so that the heavy sand settles at the bottom. Pour out the salty water (decantation) into another container, leaving sand behind.
Heat the decanted salty water in a kettle. The water turns to steam (evaporation), which can be cooled on a cold plate to recover pure water (condensation), leaving salt behind in the kettle.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Describe how filtration is used in the preparation of paneer (cottage cheese) at home.

solution_template.action: Add lemon juice to boiling milk
solution_template.explain: Adding lemon juice to boiling milk forms a mixture of solid paneer particles and a liquid whey.
Pour the mixture through a fine cloth or strainer. The solid paneer is retained on the cloth (residue) while the liquid passes through.
